scope: Finite source-backed parameter-name recovery inside already-native chemistry and drug templates. No foreign wrapper migration or value rewrite.
exclusions: No inferred Wikidata values or missing fields
No dose, pregnancy or legal-status enum conversion
No molecule-element aggregation or mass/temperature/other unit conversion
No root StdInChI mapping that loses its prefix
No accepted native English field or Chembox redirect renaming
No image-size recovery across templates with different implicit pixel units
Unknown fields and all original values remain unchanged
